moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio particle-burst, written here): Core: scale 0.72 -> 1.12 (keyframes 1.14) at 42 % -> 1, opacity 0.5 -> 1, 820 ms easeOutQuart. 8 dots 7 px at 45 deg steps start 70 ms later at the core centre at scale 0.3; by 62 % they reach an ellipse 58 x 46 px (recipe radius 54) at full size, opacity 0.85; then drift on to 1.12 x that radius while shrinking to 0.2 and fading to 0. Dots in front of the core, accent colour. Params: duration (0.82 s) · radius (54 px) · count (8) · color.
